headline: Observe native screenshot stability before choosing a repair

items.title: Observe native screenshot response and fractional scene geometry
items.insight: Observe fractional scene geometry, resolved platform fonts and native screenshot responses before selecting a repair. Keep diagnostics manual, default-false and restricted to loopback; delegate identical native options/results and log bounded image hashes without page text or secrets. Preserve the scene, assertion and old red evidence; future generation is provisional.
